_comment: The commit each dispatched APK was cut from. Updated by hand at dispatch.

lastBuild.note: Build 6 passed every GitHub Actions gate and completed EAS Android compilation from the splash-resource correction commit. EAS uploaded the internal-distribution APK and it was downloaded to the workspace. The archive passed ZIP integrity checks and contains AndroidManifest.xml, classes.dex, resources.arsc, and native libraries for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, and x86_64. No real Android device has installed or exercised it yet, so runtime native behavior remains unverified.
